claims: The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon follows a 13.1-mile point-to-point course.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course starts on Washington Avenue near the Brooklyn Museum.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course finishes in Central Park.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route takes over 30,000 runners through Brooklyn and Manhattan.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route features the Brooklyn Bridge.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route features FDR Drive.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route features Times Square.
Runners begin the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon on Washington Avenue near Sullivan Place.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route heads into Prospect Park.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route includes a loop through Prospect Park.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon Prospect Park loop involves Battle Pass Hill.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route exits toward Grand Army Plaza after the Prospect Park loop.
Runners head down Flatbush Avenue after exiting the park in the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon.
Runners cross the Brooklyn Bridge using the Manhattan-bound roadway in the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course follows FDR Drive North for approximately 4 miles.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course along FDR Drive North provides views of the East River.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course along FDR Drive North provides views of the United Nations.
Participants exit the FDR at 42nd Street in the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route passes Grand Central Terminal.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route turns north onto 7th Avenue.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon route runs through a traffic-free Times Square.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon enters Central Park at 59th Street.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon finishes on West Drive near 72nd Street.
Runners must maintain a minimum pace of approximately 13:45 per mile to meet specific checkpoint deadlines in the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon has a cutoff time of 10:20 a.m. at Brooklyn Bridge (via Brooklyn Bridge Blvd.) mile mark 4.1.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon has a cutoff time of 10:40 a.m. at FDR-bound off-ramp (to access FDR Drive) mile mark 5.4.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon has a cutoff time of 11:45 a.m. at FDR Drive Exit (to access 42nd St.) mile mark 9.4.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon has a cutoff time of 1:30 p.m. at Finish Line (Central Park) mile mark 13.1.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course is primarily paved and urban.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course has rolling segments in Central Park.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon course has moderate inclines on the bridges.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon is the only race in history that utilizes the Manhattan-bound roadway of the Brooklyn Bridge.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon set a record as the largest half marathon in NYRR history.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon had over 30,000 finishers.
